steps.contentHtml:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Solar System Adventure - All Planets</title>
  <style>
    *{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;}
    body{
      font-family:'Comic Sans MS','Comic Neue',system-ui,sans-serif;
      background:#0f0c29;
      color:#e0e7ff;
      min-height:100vh;
      position:relative;
      overflow-x:hidden;
    }
    .stars{
      position:fixed;
      top:0;left:0;
      width:100%;height:100%;
      pointer-events:none;
      background-image:
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 20px 30px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 40px 70px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 90px 40px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 130px 80px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 160px 120px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 200px 50px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 250px 160px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 300px 90px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 350px 130px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 400px 60px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 450px 180px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 500px 100px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 550px 140px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 600px 70px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 650px 190px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 700px 110px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 750px 150px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 800px 80px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 850px 170px,#fff,transparent);
      background-size:900px 200px;
      animation:twinkle 4s ease-in-out infinite;
      z-index:0;
    }
    @keyframes twinkle{0%,100%{opacity:0.3;}50%{opacity:0.8;}}
    .container{max-width:640px;margin:auto;padding:12px 14px 24px;
      position:relative;
      z-index:1;
    }
    .header{text-align:center;margin-bottom:20px;}
    h1{font-size:28px;color:#a78bfa;margin-bottom:8px;}
    .subtitle{color:#c4b5fd;font-size:16px;line-height:1.5;}
    .panel{
      background:#1a1735;
      border-radius:20px;
      padding:16px;
      margin-bottom:20px;
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    }
    .solar-panel{padding:12px;}
    .view-stage{
      position:relative;
      width:100%;
      margin:0 auto;
    }
    .view-layer{
      display:block;
      width:100%;
      height:100%;
      min-height:0;
      position:absolute;
      inset:0;
      opacity:0;
      visibility:hidden;
      transition:opacity 0.32s ease, visibility 0.32s;
      pointer-events:none;
      z-index:1;
    }
    .view-layer.active{
      opacity:1;
      visibility:visible;
      pointer-events:auto;
      z-index:2;
    }
    .view-layer-telescope.active{
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      justify-content:flex-start;
    }
    .view-layer-telescope .telescope-wrap{
      flex:0 0 auto;
      min-height:0;
      max-height:min(62vw, calc(100svh - 210px));
      height:min(62vw, calc(100svh - 210px));
    }
    .view-layer-telescope .telescope-meta{display:none;}
    .view-layer-orbit .svg-wrap{
      height:min(98vw, calc(100svh - 118px));
      max-height:min(98vw, calc(100svh - 118px));
      aspect-ratio:1;
    }
    .vertical-fit{
      height:min(98vw, calc(100svh - 118px));
      max-height:min(98vw, calc(100svh - 118px));
      width:100%;
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      overflow:hidden;
      border-radius:16px;
      background:#050510;
    }
    .vertical-fit svg{display:block;height:100%;width:auto;max-width:100%;}
    .telescope-wrap{
      height:min(98vw, calc(100svh - 118px));
      max-height:min(98vw, calc(100svh - 118px));
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:row;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      gap:8px;
      padding:8px 6px;
    }
    .tel-arrow{
      flex:0 0 auto;
      width:46px;
      height:46px;
      border:none;
      border-radius:50%;
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,#667eea,#764ba2);
      color:#fff;
      font-size:28px;
      line-height:1;
      cursor:pointer;
      box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
    }
    .tel-arrow:active{transform:scale(0.94);}
    .telescope-stage{
      flex:1 1 auto;
      max-width:min(68vw, 360px);
      aspect-ratio:1;
      border-radius:28px;
      overflow:hidden;
      background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 42%, #0a1028 0%, #020208 72%);
      box-shadow:inset 0 0 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.85), 0 0 30px rgba(255,180,60,0.08);
    }
    .telescope-stage svg{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;background:transparent;}
    .telescope-meta{
      width:100%;
      padding:0 10px 4px;
      text-align:center;
    }
    .telescope-label{
      font-size:clamp(15px, 4vw, 19px);
      font-weight:bold;
      color:#ffd700;
    }
    .telescope-detail{
      margin-top:6px;
      font-size:clamp(12px, 3.2vw, 15px);
      line-height:1.55;
      color:#c4b5fd;
    }
    .movie-wrap,.fp-wrap{
      height:min(98vw, calc(100svh - 118px));
      max-height:min(98vw, calc(100svh - 118px));
      width:100%;
      border-radius:16px;
      overflow:hidden;
      position:relative;
      background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 20%, rgba(40,30,90,0.5), #050510 70%);
    }
    .view-layer-movie.active{
      width:100%;
      height:100%;
    }
    .view-layer-movie .movie-wrap{
      aspect-ratio:800 / 560;
      height:auto;
      max-height:calc(100svh - 132px);
    }
    .view-layer-vertical.active{
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      width:100%;
      height:100%;
    }
    .view-layer-vertical .vertical-fit{
      flex:0 0 auto;
      aspect-ratio:360 / 580;
      height:auto;
      max-height:calc(100svh - 148px);
    }
    .fp-wrap::after{
      content:'';
      position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;border-radius:16px;
      box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 4px rgba(255,215,0,0.22), inset 0 -100px 90px rgba(0,0,0,0.55);
    }
    .movie-wrap svg,.fp-wrap svg{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;}
    .svg-wrap{
      background:#12102a;
      border-radius:16px;
      overflow:hidden;
      touch-action:none;
      cursor:grab;
      aspect-ratio:1;
      width:100%;
      max-width:min(100%, 520px);
      height:auto;
      margin:0 auto;
    }
    .svg-wrap{position:relative;}
    .svg-wrap:active{cursor:grabbing;}
    .svg-wrap::after{
      content:'';
      position:absolute;
      inset:0;
      pointer-events:none;
      border-radius:16px;
      box-shadow:inset 0 -40px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.55), inset 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,215,0,0.25);
      background:
        radial-gradient(ellipse 130% 90% at 50% 118%, transparent 42%, rgba(0,0,0,0.42) 100%),
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(10,8,32,0.12) 0%, rgba(10,8,32,0) 35%, rgba(10,8,32,0.45) 100%);
    }
    #solarSvg{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;min-height:0;}
    .planet-spin{will-change:transform;}
    .ctrl-row{
      display:flex;
      flex-wrap:nowrap;
      gap:6px;
      justify-content:center;
      margin-top:6px;
    }
    .ctrl-btn{
      padding:8px 10px;
      border:none;
      border-radius:10px;
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,#667eea,#764ba2);
      color:#fff;
      font-family:inherit;
      font-size:12px;
      font-weight:bold;
      cursor:pointer;
      transition:transform 0.15s;
      flex:1 1 0;
      min-width:0;
      white-space:nowrap;
    }
    .ctrl-btn:hover{transform:scale(1.05);}
    .ctrl-btn:active{transform:scale(0.95);}
    .ctrl-btn.active{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f59e0b,#ef4444);}
    .info-panel h2{color:#a78bfa;font-size:20px;margin-bottom:10px;}
    .info-panel p{font-size:16px;line-height:1.7;color:#e0e7ff;}
    .info-panel .hint{color:#c4b5fd;font-size:14px;margin-top:8px;}
    .minigame-panel h2{color:#a78bfa;font-size:20px;text-align:center;margin-bottom:8px;}
    .minigame-panel .game-desc{text-align:center;color:#c4b5fd;font-size:15px;margin-bottom:14px;line-height:1.5;}
    .progress-slots{
      display:flex;
      flex-wrap:wrap;
      gap:6px;
      justify-content:center;
      margin-bottom:16px;
    }
    .slot{
      width:36px;height:36px;
      border-radius:10px;
      background:#12102a;
      border:2px dashed rgba(167,139,250,0.4);
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      font-size:18px;
      transition:0.2s;
    }
    .slot.filled{
      border-style:solid;
      border-color:#a78bfa;
      background:#1a1735;
    }
    .planet-grid{
      display:grid;
      grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
      gap:10px;
      margin-bottom:12px;
    }
    @media(max-width:400px){.planet-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}}
    .planet-card{
      background:#12102a;
      border:2px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.3);
      border-radius:14px;
      padding:12px 8px;
      text-align:center;
      cursor:pointer;
      transition:transform 0.15s,border-color 0.15s,opacity 0.2s;
      user-select:none;
      -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;
    }
    .planet-card:hover:not(.done){transform:scale(1.05);border-color:#a78bfa;}
    .planet-card.done{opacity:0.35;pointer-events:none;cursor:default;}
    .planet-card .emoji{font-size:28px;display:block;margin-bottom:4px;}
    .planet-card .name{font-size:13px;font-weight:bold;color:#c4b5fd;}
    @keyframes shake{
      0%,100%{transform:translateX(0);}
      25%{transform:translateX(-8px);}
      75%{transform:translateX(8px);}
    }
    .planet-card.shake{animation:shake 0.35s ease-in-out;}
    .game-hint{
      text-align:center;
      font-size:15px;
      color:#fbbf24;
      min-height:22px;
      margin-bottom:10px;
    }
    .win-banner{
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(102,126,234,0.3),rgba(118,75,162,0.3));
      border:2px solid #a78bfa;
      border-radius:16px;
      padding:16px;
      text-align:center;
      margin-bottom:12px;
    }
    .win-banner.hidden{display:none;}
    .win-banner h3{color:#fbbf24;font-size:22px;margin-bottom:10px;}
    .win-banner .order-list{
      display:flex;
      flex-wrap:wrap;
      gap:6px;
      justify-content:center;
      font-size:14px;
      color:#e0e7ff;
    }
    .win-banner .order-item{
      background:#12102a;
      padding:6px 10px;
      border-radius:10px;
    }
    .play-again{
      display:block;
      margin:0 auto;
      padding:12px 28px;
      border:none;
      border-radius:12px;
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,#667eea,#764ba2);
      color:#fff;
      font-family:inherit;
      font-size:16px;
      font-weight:bold;
      cursor:pointer;
    }
    .play-again:hover{transform:scale(1.05);}
    .nav-hint{

        'pointer-events': 'none'
      }));
      this.drawMovieSphereBody(g, p, r, svg);
    },
    _vertSceneKey() {
      this.syncVerticalViewBox();
      const M = this.verticalMetrics();
      return [M.vbW, M.vbH, M.boost, M.cx].join('|');
    },
    ensureVerticalScene() {
      const key = this._vertSceneKey();
      if (this._sceneCache.verticalKey === key && this._sceneCache.vertical) return;
      const g = this.verticalG;
      const svg = document.getElementById('verticalSvg');
      if (!g || !svg) return;
      const L = VERT_LINE;
      const M = this.verticalMetrics();
      const cx = M.cx;
      const scale = M.boost * (L.sizeScale || 1);
      const sunR = L.sunR * scale;
      while (g.firstChild) g.removeChild(g.firstChild);
      this.drawSubtleSky(g, M);
      const cache = { sunSpin: null, planetSpins: {} };
      const sunY = -sunR * 0.58;
      const sunG = el('g', { class: 'planet-hit', 'data-id': 'sun', style: 'cursor:pointer' });
      g.appendChild(sunG);
      const sunInner = el('g', { class: 'planet-spin' });
      sunG.appendChild(sunInner);
      cache.sunSpin = sunInner;
      sunInner.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(' + cx + ',' + sunY.toFixed(1) + ')');
      this.drawVerticalSun(sunInner, sunR, svg);
      sunInner.appendChild(el('circle', {
        r: String(sunR * 0.95),
        fill: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.001)',
        'pointer-events': 'all'
      }));
      const step = (L.bottomY - L.topY) / (PLANETS.length + 1);
      PLANETS.forEach((p, i) => {
        const y = L.topY + step * (i + 1);
        const r = (MOVIE_SIZES[p.id] || 24) * scale;
        const hitR = p.id === 'saturn' ? r * 1.35 : r + 8;
        const pg = el('g', {
          class: 'planet-hit',
          'data-id': p.id,
          transform: 'translate(' + cx + ',' + y.toFixed(1) + ')',
          style: 'cursor:pointer'
        });
        g.appendChild(pg);
        const spinG = el('g', { class: 'planet-spin' });
        pg.appendChild(spinG);
        cache.planetSpins[p.id] = spinG;
        this.drawPlanetRealistic(spinG, p, r, svg);
        pg.appendChild(el('circle', {
          r: String(hitR),
          fill: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.001)',
          'pointer-events': 'all'
        }));
      });
      this._sceneCache.vertical = cache;
      this._sceneCache.verticalKey = key;
      this.updateVerticalAnim();
    },
    updateVerticalAnim() {
      const cache = this._sceneCache.vertical;
      if (!cache) return;
      if (cache.sunSpin) {
        const base = cache.sunSpin.getAttribute('data-base') || cache.sunSpin.getAttribute('transform') || '';
        if (!cache.sunSpin.getAttribute('data-base')) cache.sunSpin.setAttribute('data-base', base);
        const spin = (this.sunSpin || 0).toFixed(2);
        cache.sunSpin.setAttribute('transform', base + ' rotate(' + spin + ')');
      }
      PLANETS.forEach(p => {
        const spinG = cache.planetSpins[p.id];
        if (spinG) {
          spinG.setAttribute('transform', 'rotate(' + (this.spinAngles[p.id] || 0).toFixed(2) + ')');
        }
      });
    },
    _orbitSceneKey() {
      const M = this.syncOrbitViewBox() || {};
      const mode = this.currentMode();
      const layout = this.effectiveOrbitLayout(mode);
      return [
        M.vbW, M.vbH, M.wide ? 1 : 0,
        layout.tilt, layout.orbitScale, layout.sunRadius,
        layout.sunOffsetX, layout.planetSizeScale, mode.id
      ].join('|');
    },
    ensureOrbitScene() {
      const key = this._orbitSceneKey();
      if (this._sceneCache.orbitKey === key && this._sceneCache.orbit) return;
      const M = this.syncOrbitViewBox() || { vbW: 600, vbH: 600, x0: 0, y0: 0, cx: 300, cy: 300 };
      let skyG = this.svg.querySelector('#orbitSkyGroup');
      if (!skyG) {
        skyG = el('g', { id: 'orbitSkyGroup' });
        this.svg.insertBefore(skyG, this.viewG);
      }
      while (skyG.firstChild) skyG.removeChild(skyG.firstChild);
      this.drawSubtleSky(skyG, M);
      while (this.viewG.firstChild) this.viewG.removeChild(this.viewG.firstChild);
      const mode = this.currentMode();
      const layout = this.effectiveOrbitLayout(mode);
      const wide = M.wide || this.orbitStageWide();
      const sunR = layout.sunRadius;
      const sunX = layout.sunOffsetX;
      const hostSvg = this.svg;
      const cache = {
        backG: el('g', { id: 'orbitBackPlanets' }),
        frontG: el('g', { id: 'orbitFrontPlanets' }),
        planets: {},
        sunG: null,
      };
      this.viewG.appendChild(el('g', { id: 'orbitEllipses' }));
      this.viewG.appendChild(cache.backG);
      const sunG = el('g', {
        id: 'sunHit',
        class: 'planet-hit',
        'data-id': 'sun',
        transform: 'translate(' + sunX + ',0)',
        style: 'cursor:pointer'
      });
      this.viewG.appendChild(sunG);
      cache.sunG = sunG;
      this.drawSun(sunG, sunR, hostSvg);
      this.viewG.appendChild(cache.frontG);
      this.visiblePlanets(mode).forEach(p => {
        const orbitR = this.displayOrbitR(p, layout);
        this.viewG.firstChild.appendChild(el('ellipse', {
          cx: sunX, cy: 0, rx: orbitR, ry: orbitR * Math.abs(layout.tilt),
          fill: 'none',
          stroke: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.42)',
          'stroke-width': wide ? '1.8' : '1.5'
        }));
        const drawSize = p.size * layout.planetSizeScale;
        const pg = el('g', {
          class: 'planet-hit',
          'data-id': p.id,
          style: 'cursor:pointer'
        });
        const spinG = el('g', { class: 'planet-spin' });
        pg.appendChild(spinG);
        this.drawPlanetBody(spinG, p, drawSize, hostSvg);
        cache.planets[p.id] = { pg: pg, spinG: spinG };
      });
      this._sceneCache.orbit = cache;
      this._sceneCache.orbitKey = key;
      this.updateOrbitAnim();
    },
    updateOrbitAnim() {
      const cache = this._sceneCache.orbit;
      if (!cache || !this.viewG) return;
      const mode = this.currentMode();
      const layout = this.effectiveOrbitLayout(mode);
      const cx = 300;
      const cy = mode.viewCy != null ? mode.viewCy : (this.VIEW_CY || 300);
      const rot = this.rot + this.drag;
      const tilt = layout.tilt;
      const sunX = layout.sunOffsetX;
      this.viewG.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(' + cx + ',' + cy + ') rotate(' + rot + ') scale(' + this.zoom + ')');
      const drawList = this.buildPlanetDrawList(mode, null, tilt, layout).sort((a, b) => a.py - b.py);
      drawList.forEach(item => {
        const node = cache.planets[item.p.id];
        if (!node) return;
        const spin = (this.spinAngles[item.p.id] || 0).toFixed(2);
        node.pg.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(' + item.px.toFixed(2) + ',' + item.py.toFixed(2) + ') scale(' + item.scale.toFixed(3) + ')');
        node.spinG.setAttribute('transform', 'rotate(' + spin + ')');
        const parent = item.py < 0 ? cache.backG : cache.frontG;
        if (node.pg.parentNode !== parent) parent.appendChild(node.pg);
      });
      if (cache.sunG) {
        cache.sunG.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(' + sunX + ',0)');
      }
    },
    _telescopeSceneKey() {
      return String(this.telescopeIdx);
    },
    ensureTelescopeScene() {
      const key = this._telescopeSceneKey();
      if (this._sceneCache.telescopeKey === key && this._sceneCache.telescope) return;
      const g = this.telescopeG;
      const svg = document.getElementById('telescopeSvg');
      if (!g || !svg) return;
      const M = this.syncStageViewBox('telescopeSvg', 400, 400, 'tele');
      if (!M) return;
      while (g.firstChild) g.removeChild(g.firstChild);
      g.appendChild(el('rect', { x: String(M.x0), y: String(M.y0), width: String(M.vbW), height: String(M.vbH), fill: '#030308' }));
      const starCount = LOW_GPU ? 36 : 72;
      for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
        g.appendChild(el('circle', {
          cx: String(M.x0 + ((i * 53.7 + 12) % Math.max(1, M.vbW - 12))),
          cy: String(M.y0 + ((i * 91.3 + 28) % Math.max(1, M.vbH - 12))),
          r: String(0.35 + (i % 5) * 0.22),
          fill: 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (0.2 + (i % 7) * 0.1).toFixed(2) + ')'
        }));
      }
      if (!svg.querySelector('#telVignette')) {
        let defs = svg.querySelector('defs');
        if (!defs) {
          defs = el('defs', {});
          svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);
        }
        const rg = el('radialGradient', { id: 'telVignette', cx: '50%', cy: '48%', r: '58%' });
        rg.appendChild(el('stop', { offset: '50%', 'stop-color': 'rgba(0,0,0,0)' }));
        rg.appendChild(el('stop', { offset: '100%', 'stop-color': 'rgba(0,0,0,0.75)' }));
        defs.appendChild(rg);
      }
      const contentG = el('g', {
        transform: 'translate(' + M.cx.toFixed(2) + ',' + M.cy.toFixed(2) + ') scale(' + M.boost.toFixed(4) + ') translate(-200,-200)'
      });
      g.appendChild(contentG);
      const p = PLANETS[this.telescopeIdx];
      const pg = el('g', {
        class: 'planet-hit',
        'data-id': p.id,
        transform: 'translate(200,200)',
        style: 'cursor:pointer'
      });
      contentG.appendChild(pg);
      const spinG = el('g', { class: 'planet-spin' });
      pg.appendChild(spinG);
      this.drawPlanetSoft(spinG, p, TELESCOPE_DRAW_R, svg);
      g.appendChild(el('rect', {
        x: String(M.x0), y: String(M.y0), width: String(M.vbW), height: String(M.vbH),
        fill: 'url(#telVignette)', 'pointer-events': 'none', opacity: '0.45'
      }));
      this._sceneCache.telescope = { spinG: spinG };
      this._sceneCache.telescopeKey = key;
      this.updateTelescopeAnim();
    },
    updateTelescopeAnim() {
      const cache = this._sceneCache.telescope;
      if (!cache || !cache.spinG) return;
      const p = PLANETS[this.telescopeIdx];
      cache.spinG.setAttribute('transform', 'rotate(' + (this.spinAngles[p.id] || 0).toFixed(2) + ')');
    },
    _movieSceneKey() {
      const M = this.syncMovieViewBox();
      if (!M) return '';
      return [M.vbW, M.vbH, M.wide ? 1 : 0, M.boost].join('|');
    },
    ensureMovieScene() {
      const key = this._movieSceneKey();
      if (this._sceneCache.movieKey === key && this._sceneCache.movie) return;
      const g = this.movieG;
      const svg = document.getElementById('movieSvg');
      if (!g || !svg) return;
      const ML = MOVIE_LAYOUT;
      const M = this.syncMovieViewBox();
      if (!M) return;
      while (g.firstChild) g.removeChild(g.firstChild);
      this.drawSubtleSky(g, M);
      let contentG;
      let startX;
      let endX;
      let sunR;
      if (M.wide) {
        contentG = el('g', {
          transform: 'translate(' + M.originX.toFixed(2) + ',' + M.cy.toFixed(2) + ') scale(' + M.boost.toFixed(4) + ') translate(0,' + (-ML.centerY) + ')'
        });
        startX = M.rowStartX;
        endX = M.rowEndX;
        sunR = ML.sunR;
      } else {
        contentG = el('g', {
          transform: 'translate(' + M.cx.toFixed(2) + ',' + M.cy.toFixed(2) + ') scale(' + M.boost.toFixed(4) + ') translate(' + (-ML.centerX) + ',' + (-ML.centerY) + ')'
        });
        startX = ML.startX;
        endX = ML.endX;
        sunR = ML.sunR;
      }
      g.appendChild(contentG);
      const glowPad = Math.ceil(sunR * 0.22);
      const sunWrap = el('g', { 'clip-path': 'url(#movieSunLeftClip)' });
      let defs = svg.querySelector('defs');
      if (!defs) {
        defs = el('defs', {});
        svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);
      }
      let cp = svg.querySelector('#movieSunLeftClip');
      if (!cp) {
        cp = el('clipPath', { id: 'movieSunLeftClip' });
        defs.appendChild(cp);
      }
      while (cp.firstChild) cp.removeChild(cp.firstChild);
      cp.appendChild(el('rect', {
        x: '0',
        y: String(-glowPad),
        width: '460',
        height: String(ML.contentH + glowPad * 2)
      }));
      contentG.appendChild(sunWrap);
      const sunG = el('g', {
        transform: 'translate(' + ML.sunCX + ',' + ML.centerY + ')',
        class: 'planet-hit',
        id: 'sunHit',
        'data-id': 'sun',
        style: 'cursor:pointer'
      });
      sunWrap.appendChild(sunG);
      this.drawSunBurning(sunG, sunR, svg, null);
      const cache = { planetSpins: {} };
      const lineY = ML.centerY;
      const gap = (endX - startX) / (PLANETS.length - 1);
      PLANETS.forEach((p, i) => {
        const x = startX + gap * i;
        const r = MOVIE_SIZES[p.id] || 24;
        const pg = el('g', {
          class: 'planet-hit',
          'data-id': p.id,
          transform: 'translate(' + x.toFixed(1) + ',' + lineY + ')',
          style: 'cursor:pointer'
        });
        contentG.appendChild(pg);
        const spinG = el('g', { class: 'planet-spin' });
        pg.appendChild(spinG);
        cache.planetSpins[p.id] = spinG;
        this.drawMoviePlanet(spinG, p, r, svg);
      });
      this._sceneCache.movie = cache;
      this._sceneCache.movieKey = key;
      this.updateMovieAnim();
    },
    updateMovieAnim() {
      const cache = this._sceneCache.movie;
      if (!cache) return;
      PLANETS.forEach(p => {
        const spinG = cache.planetSpins[p.id];
        if (spinG) {
          spinG.setAttribute('transform', 'rotate(' + (this.spinAngles[p.id] || 0).toFixed(2) + ')');
        }
      });
    },
    drawOrbit(){
      this.ensureOrbitScene();
      this.updateOrbitAnim();
    },
    drawVertical() {
      this.ensureVerticalScene();
      this.updateVerticalAnim();
    },
    drawTelescope() {
      this.ensureTelescopeScene();
      this.updateTelescopeAnim();
    },
    drawMovie() {
      this.ensureMovieScene();
      this.updateMovieAnim();
    },
    loop(){
      const layer = this.activeLayer();
      if (this.playing){
        const mult = SPEEDS[this.speedIdx];
        PLANETS.forEach(p => {
          this.angles[p.id] += p.baseSpeed * mult;
          this.spinAngles[p.id] = (this.spinAngles[p.id] || 0) + 0.5 * mult;
        });
        this.sunSpin = (this.sunSpin || 0) + 0.35 * mult;
      }
      this.tickActiveView();
      requestAnimationFrame(() => this.loop());
    }
  };

  /* ── Order the Planets Minigame ── */
  const Game = {
    step: 0, done: false,
    init(){
      this.slots = document.getElementById('progressSlots');
      this.grid = document.getElementById('planetGrid');
      this.hint = document.getElementById('gameHint');
      this.win = document.getElementById('winBanner');
      this.orderList = document.getElementById('orderList');
      document.getElementById('playAgain').onclick = () => this.reset();
      this.reset();
    },
    reset(){
      this.step = 0;
      this.done = false;
      this.win.classList.add('hidden');
      this.hint.textContent = 'Tap Mercury first — it\'s the closest to the Sun!';
      this.slots.innerHTML = '';
      for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++){
        const s = document.createElement('div');
        s.className = 'slot';
        s.textContent = i + 1;
        this.slots.appendChild(s);
      }
      this.orderList.innerHTML = '';
      PLANET_ORDER.forEach(name => {
        const p = PLANETS.find(x => x.name === name);
        const item = document.createElement('span');
        item.className = 'order-item';
        item.textContent = p.emoji + ' ' + name;
        this.orderList.appendChild(item);
      });
      const shuffled = [...PLANETS].sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5);
      this.grid.innerHTML = '';
      shuffled.forEach(p => {
        const card = document.createElement('div');
        card.className = 'planet-card';
        card.dataset.name = p.name;
        card.innerHTML = '<span class="emoji">' + p.emoji + '</span><span class="name">' + p.name + '</span>';
        card.onclick = () => this.tap(card, p);
        this.grid.appendChild(card);
      });
    },
    tap(card, p){
      if (this.done || card.classList.contains('done')) return;
      const expected = PLANET_ORDER[this.step];
      if (p.name === expected){
        card.classList.add('done');
        const slot = this.slots.children[this.step];
        slot.textContent = p.emoji;
        slot.classList.add('filled');
        this.step++;
        if (this.step >= 8){
          this.done = true;
          this.win.classList.remove('hidden');
          this.hint.textContent = '🌟 Amazing! You know the order of the planets!';
        } else {
          const next = PLANET_ORDER[this.step];
          const nextP = PLANETS.find(x => x.name === next);
          this.hint.textContent = 'Nice! Now tap ' + next + ' ' + nextP.emoji;
        }
      } else {
        card.classList.add('shake');
        setTimeout(() => card.classList.remove('shake'), 350);
        const nextP = PLANETS.find(x => x.name === expected);
        this.hint.textContent = 'Not quite! Hint: tap ' + expected + ' ' + nextP.emoji + ' next.';
      }
    }
  };

  Game.init();
  try { Solar.init(); } catch (err) { console.error('Solar viewer:', err); }
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

steps.title: OurSolarSystem Explained
steps.contentHtml:
📚 Our Solar System Explained

Learn how our cosmic neighborhood works!

🌟 What is the Solar System?

The solar system is our cosmic neighborhood in space. It's like a big family with the Sun at the center and all the planets orbiting around it.

Orbit means going around in a circle. Just like the Moon orbits around Earth, all the planets orbit around the Sun!

☀️ The Sun - Our Star

The Sun is a star, not a planet! It's a huge ball of hot, glowing gas that gives us light and heat. Without the Sun, Earth would be freezing cold and dark.

💡 Fun Fact

The Sun is so big that over 1 million Earths could fit inside it!

🪐 The 8 Planets

There are 8 planets in our solar system. They are divided into two groups:

  • Inner Planets (closer to the Sun): Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars
  • Outer Planets (farther from the Sun): Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune

📏 Order from the Sun

☀️
The Sun
Center of our system
🪨
Mercury
Smallest planet
🔥
Venus
Hottest planet
🌍
Earth
Our home
🔴
Mars
The red planet
🟠
Jupiter
Biggest planet
💍
Saturn
Has beautiful rings
🔵
Uranus
Ice giant
🔷
Neptune
Windiest planet

🌙 Other Objects in Space

Besides the Sun and planets, our solar system has many other interesting things:

  • Moons - Many planets have moons that orbit around them
  • Asteroids - Rocky objects that orbit the Sun, mostly between Mars and Jupiter
  • Comets - Dirty snowballs that leave beautiful tails when they get close to the Sun

🚀 Why is Earth Special?

Earth is the only planet we know of that has life! It's just the right distance from the Sun - not too hot and not too cold. It has water, air, and everything living things need.

💡 Fun Fact

Earth is often called the "Goldilocks Planet" because it's just right for life!

})(window);
</script>
</head>
<body class="reading-page">
<div class="stars"></div>
<div class="container">
  <div class="header">
    <h1>❓ Solar System Quiz</h1>
  </div>

  <div class="competition-bar" id="liveScoreBar">
    <div class="competitor">
      <div class="competitor-icon" id="playerIcon">👨‍🚀</div>
      <div class="competitor-name" id="playerName2">Explorer</div>
      <div class="competitor-score" id="playerScore">0</div>
    </div>
    <div class="vs-divider">VS</div>
    <div class="competitor">
      <div class="competitor-icon" id="botIcon">🤖</div>
      <div class="competitor-name" id="botName">SolarBot</div>
      <div class="competitor-score" id="computerScore">0</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card active" id="quizCard-1">
    <div class="question">1. What is at the center of our solar system?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, false)">Earth</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, true)">The Sun</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, false)">Jupiter</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, false)">The Moon</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-1"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-2">
    <div class="question">2. How many planets are in our solar system?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, false)">7</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, false)">9</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, true)">8</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, false)">10</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-2"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-3">
    <div class="question">3. Which planet is known as the "Red Planet"?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, false)">Venus</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, true)">Mars</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, false)">Jupiter</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, false)">Saturn</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-3"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-4">
    <div class="question">4. Which planet is the largest?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, false)">Earth</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, false)">Saturn</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, true)">Jupiter</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, false)">Neptune</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-4"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-5">
    <div class="question">5. Which planet has beautiful rings?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, false)">Jupiter</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, true)">Saturn</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, false)">Uranus</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, false)">Neptune</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-5"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-6">
    <div class="question">6. Which planet is the hottest?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 6, false)">Mercury</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 6, true)">Venus</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 6, false)">Mars</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 6, false)">The Sun</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-6"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-7">
    <div class="question">7. Which planet is the smallest?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 7, true)">Mercury</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 7, false)">Venus</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 7, false)">Mars</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 7, false)">Earth</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-7"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-8">
    <div class="question">8. Which planet is our home?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 8, false)">Mars</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 8, false)">Venus</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 8, true)">Earth</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 8, false)">Jupiter</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-8"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="score-card" id="scoreCard">
    <h2>🎉 Quiz Complete!</h2>
    <div class="podium" id="podium">
      <div class="podium-place" id="podium-second">
        <div class="podium-character" id="podium-char-2">🤖</div>
        <div class="podium-bar second">
          <span class="rank-badge">🥈</span>
        </div>
        <div class="podium-score" id="podium-score-2">0</div>
        <div class="podium-name" id="podium-name-2">SolarBot</div>
      </div>
      <div class="podium-place" id="podium-first">
        <div class="podium-character" id="podium-char-1">👨‍🚀</div>
        <div class="podium-bar first">
          <span class="rank-badge">🥇</span>
        </div>
        <div class="podium-score" id="podium-score-1">0</div>
        <div class="podium-name" id="podium-name-1">Ariel</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="message" id="scoreMessage"></div>
    <div class="button-group">
      <button class="retry-btn" onclick="retryQuiz()">🔄 Try Again</button>
    </div>
  </div>

<div class="nav-hint">
  <div>💡 Use the ← → arrows in the top navigation bar to go to the next chapter.</div>
  <div>💡 Use the 🏠 button in the top navigation bar to go back to the Home page.</div>
</div>

</div>

<script>
let score = 0;
let currentQuestion = 1;
const totalQuestions = 8;
let computerScore = 0;

function checkAnswer(element, questionNum, isCorrect) {
  const parent = element.parentElement;
  const options = parent.querySelectorAll('.option');
  const feedback = document.getElementById('feedback-' + questionNum);
  
  options.forEach(opt => {
    opt.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
  });
  
  // Computer answers randomly (70% chance of being correct)
  const computerCorrect = Math.random() < 0.7;
  if (computerCorrect) {
    computerScore++;
    document.getElementById('computerScore').textContent = computerScore;
  }
  
  if (isCorrect) {
    element.classList.add('correct');
    feedback.textContent = '✅ Correct! Great job!';
    feedback.className = 'feedback show correct';
    score++;
    document.getElementById('playerScore').textContent = score;
  } else {
    element.classList.add('wrong');
    feedback.textContent = '❌ Not quite. Try again next time!';
    feedback.className = 'feedback show wrong';
  }
  
  setTimeout(() => {
    nextQuestion();
  }, 1500);
}

function nextQuestion() {
  const currentCard = document.getElementById('quizCard-' + currentQuestion);
  currentCard.classList.remove('active');
  
  currentQuestion++;
  
  if (currentQuestion <= totalQuestions) {
    const nextCard = document.getElementById('quizCard-' + currentQuestion);
    nextCard.classList.add('active');
  } else {
    showScore();
  }
}


function showScore() {
  const scoreCard = document.getElementById('scoreCard');
  const scoreMessage = document.getElementById('scoreMessage');
  const podium = document.getElementById('podium');
  
  
  const userName = SolarPlayer.getUserName() || 'Explorer';
  const userCharacter = SolarPlayer.getCharacter() || '👨‍🚀';
  const botName = 'SolarBot';
  const botCharacter = '🤖';
  
  // Create competitors array with scores
  const competitors = [
    { name: userName, character: userCharacter, score: score, isPlayer: true },
    { name: botName, character: botCharacter, score: computerScore, isPlayer: false }
  ];
  
  // Sort by score (descending)
  competitors.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
  
  // Update podium
  document.getElementById('podium-char-1').textContent = competitors[0].character;
  document.getElementById('podium-name-1').textContent = competitors[0].name;
  document.getElementById('podium-score-1').textContent = competitors[0].score;
  
  document.getElementById('podium-char-2').textContent = competitors[1].character;
  document.getElementById('podium-name-2').textContent = competitors[1].name;
  document.getElementById('podium-score-2').textContent = competitors[1].score;
  
  // Update message
  if (competitors[0].isPlayer) {
    scoreMessage.textContent = '🎉 ' + userName + ' wins! Amazing job!';
  } else {
    scoreMessage.textContent = competitors[0].name + ' won this time. Try again!';
  }
  
  document.getElementById('liveScoreBar').classList.add('hidden');
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
  podium.style.display = 'flex';
  scoreCard.classList.add('show');
}

function retryQuiz() {
  score = 0;
  currentQuestion = 1;
  computerScore = 0;
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-card').forEach((card, index) => {
    card.classList.remove('active');
    if (index === 0) card.classList.add('active');
  });
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.option').forEach(opt => {
    opt.classList.remove('correct', 'wrong');
    opt.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
  });
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.feedback').forEach(fb => {
    fb.classList.remove('show', 'correct', 'wrong');
  });
  
  document.getElementById('scoreCard').classList.remove('show');
  document.getElementById('liveScoreBar').classList.remove('hidden');
  document.getElementById('playerScore').textContent = '0';
  document.getElementById('computerScore').textContent = '0';
}

// Load player info from page 3 character selection
function loadPlayerInfo() {
  const userName = SolarPlayer.getUserName() || 'Explorer';
  const userCharacter = SolarPlayer.getCharacter() || '👨‍🚀';
  const playerName2 = document.getElementById('playerName2');
  const playerIcon = document.getElementById('playerIcon');
  const podiumChar = document.getElementById('podium-char-1');
  const podiumName = document.getElementById('podium-name-1');
  if (playerName2) playerName2.textContent = userName;
  if (playerIcon) playerIcon.textContent = userCharacter;
  if (podiumChar) podiumChar.textContent = userCharacter;
  if (podiumName) podiumName.textContent = userName;
}
loadPlayerInfo();

</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Solar System Adventure - The Sun</title>
  <style>
    *{
      margin:0;
      padding:0;
      box-sizing:border-box;
    }
    body{
      font-family:'Comic Sans MS','Comic Neue',system-ui,sans-serif;
      background:#0f0c29;
      color:#e0e7ff;
      min-height:100vh;
      position:relative;
      overflow-x:hidden;
    }
    .stars{
      position:fixed;
      top:0;
      left:0;
      width:100%;
      height:100%;
      pointer-events:none;
      background-image:
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 20px 30px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 40px 70px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 90px 40px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 130px 80px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 160px 120px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 200px 50px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 250px 160px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 300px 90px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 350px 130px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 400px 60px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 450px 180px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 500px 100px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 550px 140px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 600px 70px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 650px 190px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 700px 110px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 750px 150px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 800px 80px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 850px 170px,#fff,transparent);
      background-size:900px 200px;
      animation:twinkle 4s ease-in-out infinite;
      z-index:0;
    }
    @keyframes twinkle{
      0%,100%{opacity:0.3;}
      50%{opacity:0.8;}
    }
    .container{
      max-width:640px;
      margin:auto;
      padding:24px 16px 40px;
      position:relative;
      z-index:1;
    }
    .header{
      text-align:center;
      margin-bottom:20px;
    }
    h1{
      font-size:32px;
      color:#ffd700;
      margin-bottom:8px;
    }
    .subtitle{
      color:#c4b5fd;
      font-size:16px;
    }
    .sun-display{
      display:flex;
      justify-content:center;
      align-items:center;
      margin:30px 0;
    }
    .sun{
      width:150px;
      height:150px;
      background:radial-gradient(circle,#ffd700,#ff8c00);
      border-radius:50%;
      box-shadow:0 0 80px #ffd700,0 0 120px #ff8c00;
      animation:pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
      cursor:pointer;
      transition:transform 0.3s;
    }
    .sun:hover{
      transform:scale(1.1);
    }
    @keyframes pulse{
      0%,100%{transform:scale(1);}
      50%{transform:scale(1.05);}
    }
    .card{
      background:#1a1735;
      backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
      border-radius:20px;
      padding:20px;
      margin-bottom:16px;
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    }
    .card h2{
      color:#ffd700;
      margin-bottom:12px;
      font-size:20px;
    }
    .card p{
      font-size:16px;
      line-height:1.7;
      margin-bottom:10px;
    }
    .fact-box{
      background:rgba(251,191,36,0.2);
      border-left:6px solid #fbbf24;
      padding:16px;
      border-radius:12px;
      margin-top:12px;
    }
    .fact-box h3{
      color:#fbbf24;
      margin-bottom:8px;
      font-size:18px;
    }
    .fact-box p{
      font-size:15px;
      line-height:1.6;
      margin:0;
    }
    .stats-grid{
      display:grid;
      grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);
      gap:12px;
      margin-top:12px;
    }
    .stat-item{
      background:rgba(255,215,0,0.1);
      border-radius:12px;
      padding:14px;
      text-align:center;
    }
    .stat-label{
      font-size:13px;
      color:#c4b5fd;
      margin-bottom:4px;
    }
    .stat-value{
      font-size:18px;
      font-weight:bold;
      color:#ffd700;
    }
    .nav-hint{
      margin-top:20px;
      text-align:center;
      font-size:13px;
      color:#a78bfa;
      background:rgba(167,139,250,0.1);
      padding:10px;
      border-radius:10px;
    }
    .sun-game{
      background:#1a1735;
      backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
      border-radius:20px;
      padding:20px;
      margin-top:20px;
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    }
    .sun-game h2{color:#ffd700;margin-bottom:8px;font-size:20px;text-align:center;}
    .sun-game .game-desc{text-align:center;color:#c4b5fd;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:14px;line-height:1.55;}
    .game-canvas-wrap{position:relative;height:min(50vh,440px);min-height:min(42vh,300px);max-height:min(56vh,480px);background:#12102a;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;touch-action:none;cursor:grab;}
    .game-canvas-wrap:active{cursor:grabbing;}
    .game-hud-float{position:absolute;top:8px;left:8px;right:8px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:6px;z-index:6;pointer-events:none;}
    .game-hud-float span{background:rgba(0,0,0,0.65);padding:5px 10px;border-radius:8px;font-size:12px;font-weight:bold;color:#ffd700;border:1px solid rgba(255,215,0,0.35);}
    .game-drag-hint{
      position:absolute;
      bottom:8px;
      left:50%;
      transform:translateX(-50%);
      z-index:6;
      pointer-events:none;
      max-width:calc(100% - 16px);
      padding:5px 10px;
      border-radius:999px;
      background:rgba(0,0,0,0.62);
      border:1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.35);
      color:#c4b5fd;
      font-size:11px;
      font-weight:bold;
      text-align:center;
      white-space:nowrap;
    }
    #sunGameCanvas{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;}
    .game-canvas-wrap .game-overlay{
      position:absolute;
      top:50%;
      left:50%;
      transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      gap:10px;
      box-sizing:border-box;
      width:min(92%,300px);
      max-width:calc(100% - 16px);
      max-height:calc(100% - 20px);
      overflow-y:auto;
      -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;
      background:rgba(8,6,24,0.94);
      padding:16px 14px;
      border-radius:14px;
      text-align:center;
      border:2px solid #ffd700;
      z-index:10;
    }
    .game-overlay h3{
      color:#ffd700;
      margin:0;
      font-size:clamp(15px,4.2vw,20px);
      line-height:1.25;
    }
    .game-overlay p{
      color:#ddd;
      margin:0;
      font-size:clamp(11px,3vw,14px);
      line-height:1.45;
      max-width:100%;
    }
    .overlay-btn{
      flex-shrink:0;
      margin-top:2px;
      padding:9px 22px;
      border:none;
      border-radius:12px;
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,#667eea,#764ba2);
      color:#fff;
      font-size:clamp(13px,3.5vw,15px);
      font-weight:bold;
      cursor:pointer;
    }
    @media (max-height: 700px) {
      .game-canvas-wrap .game-overlay {
        padding: 12px;

    .game-hud{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:12px;}
    .game-hud-item{background:#1a1735;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:8px;font-size:15px;font-weight:bold;color:#ffd700;border:1px solid rgba(255,215,0,0.45);}

    .planet-info-panel{margin-top:10px;min-height:52px;padding:12px 14px;background:#1a1735;border-radius:12px;border-left:4px solid #ffd700;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;}

    .game-hud{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:12px;}

    .game-canvas{position:relative;}

// ☀️ Solar Climb — Mario-style platform climb to the Sun
let sunCanvas, sunCtx, sunRunning = false;
let sunPlayer, sunPlatforms = [], sunFlares = [], sunCamY = 0;

let sunTime = 90, sunLives = 3, sunHeight = 0, sunAnimId, sunTimerId;

function sunPhysicsFor(w, h) {
  const scale = Math.max(1, Math.min(w, h) / 380);
  const grav = 0.58;
  const jumpV = -10.2 * Math.min(1.28, 0.9 + scale * 0.14);
  const speed = 4.8 * Math.min(1.22, 0.94 + scale * 0.1);
  const maxJumpH = (jumpV * jumpV) / (2 * grav) * 0.88;
  const airFrames = (-2 * jumpV / grav) * 0.9;
  const maxJumpX = speed * airFrames * 0.88;
  return { grav: grav, jumpV: jumpV, speed: speed, maxJumpH: maxJumpH, maxJumpX: maxJumpX };
}

function startSunClimb() {
  const wrap = document.getElementById('sunGameWrap');

  const sunW = Math.max(104, 108);
  const plats = [{
    x: sunCx - sunW / 2,
    y: SUN_CENTER_Y,
    width: sunW,
    h: 14,
    isSun: true,
    sunR: SUN_BODY_RADIUS,
    sunCx: sunCx,
    sunCy: SUN_CENTER_Y

  const gapMin = Math.max(22, phys.maxJumpH * 0.36);
  const gapMax = Math.max(gapMin + 8, phys.maxJumpH * 0.5);
  const maxDx = Math.min(phys.maxJumpX, w * 0.34);
  const sunBottom = SUN_CENTER_Y + SUN_BODY_RADIUS;
  const minPlatY = sunBottom + gapMin * 0.82;
  const steps = Math.max(28, Math.round(h * 2.6 / gapMin));
  let y = h - 20;
  const startW = Math.max(88, Math.min(w - 24, 124));
  let prevCx = sunCx;
  plats.push({ x: prevCx - startW / 2, y: y, width: startW, h: 14, isStart: true });
  for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
    const nextY = y - (gapMin + Math.random() * (gapMax - gapMin));
    if (nextY < minPlatY) break;
    y = nextY;
    const pw = Math.max(72, Math.min(w * 0.3, 78 + Math.random() * 36));
    const dx = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * maxDx;
    let cx = prevCx + dx;
    cx = Math.max(pw / 2 + 10, Math.min(w - pw / 2 - 10, cx));
    plats.push({ x: cx - pw / 2, y: y, width: pw, h: 14 });

  const closest = regular.reduce((a, b) => (a.y < b.y ? a : b), regular[0]);

  if (!closest || closest.y > approachTop + gapMax * 0.55) {
    const pw = Math.max(84, Math.min(w * 0.34, 102));
    plats.push({ x: sunCx - pw / 2, y: approachTop, width: pw, h: 14, isApproach: true });
  }
  return plats.filter(p => p.isSun || p.y >= minPlatY - 4);
}

function resetSunDrag() {
  sunDragMove = 0;
  sunDragPointerId = null;
}

function bindSunDragControls() {
  const wrap = document.getElementById('sunGameWrap');
  if (!wrap || wrap._dragBound) return;
  wrap._dragBound = true;
  const DRAG_DEAD = 10;
  const MOVE_SCALE = 72;
  const FLICK_UP = -32;
  const TAP_MAX_DIST = 18;
  const TAP_MAX_MS = 280;

  function onDown(e) {
    if (!sunRunning || e.target.closest('.game-overlay') || e.target.closest('.overlay-btn')) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    sunDragPointerId = e.pointerId;
    sunDragStartX = e.clientX;
    sunDragStartY = e.clientY;
    sunDragStartTime = Date.now();
    sunDragMove = 0;
    wrap.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
  }

  function onMove(e) {
    if (sunDragPointerId !== e.pointerId || !sunRunning) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const dx = e.clientX - sunDragStartX;
    const dy = e.clientY - sunDragStartY;
    if (Math.abs(dx) > DRAG_DEAD) {
      sunDragMove = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, dx / MOVE_SCALE));
    } else {
      sunDragMove = 0;
    }
    if (dy < FLICK_UP && sunPlayer && sunPlayer.onGround) {
      sunJumpReq = true;
      sunDragStartY = e.clientY;
    }
  }

  function onUp(e) {
    if (sunDragPointerId !== e.pointerId) return;
    const dx = e.clientX - sunDragStartX;
    const dy = e.clientY - sunDragStartY;
    const elapsed = Date.now() - sunDragStartTime;
    const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
    if ((dist < TAP_MAX_DIST && elapsed < TAP_MAX_MS) || dy < FLICK_UP) {
      sunJumpReq = true;
    }
    resetSunDrag();
  }

  wrap.addEventListener('pointerdown', onDown);
  wrap.addEventListener('pointermove', onMove);
  wrap.addEventListener('pointerup', onUp);
  wrap.addEventListener('pointercancel', onUp);
}

function sunKeyDown(e) {
  if (!sunRunning) return;
  if (['ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','ArrowUp',' '].includes(e.key)) e.preventDefault();
  if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') sunKeys.left = true;
  if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') sunKeys.right = true;
  if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'w' || e.key === ' ') sunJumpReq = true;
}

function sunKeyUp(e) {
  if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') sunKeys.left = false;
  if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') sunKeys.right = false;
}

function updateSunHud() {
  document.getElementById('sunGameTimer').textContent = '⏱ ' + sunTime + 's | ' + '❤️'.repeat(sunLives) + '🖤'.repeat(Math.max(0, 3 - sunLives));
}

function sunBottomCamY(plat, canvasH) {
  if (!plat) return 0;
  return Math.max(0, plat.y + plat.h - canvasH + 6);
}

function playerTouchesSun(p) {
  const sun = sunPlatforms.find(pl => pl.isSun);
  if (!sun) return false;
  const cx = sun.sunCx || (sun.x + sun.width / 2);
  const cy = sun.sunCy || sun.y;
  const sunR = sun.sunR || SUN_BODY_RADIUS;
  const hitR = sunR + SUN_RAY_LEN + 12;
  const dx = p.x - cx;
  const dy = p.y - cy;
  if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) <= hitR) return true;
  const pad = 16;
  return p.y <= cy + sunR + pad &&
    p.y >= cy - sunR - SUN_RAY_LEN &&
    Math.abs(p.x - cx) <= sunR + SUN_RAY_LEN + pad;
}

function endSunClimb(won) {
  sunRunning = false;
  sunKeys = {}; sunDragMove = 0; sunJumpReq = false;
  resetSunDrag();
  const dragHint = document.getElementById('sunDragHint');
  if (dragHint) dragHint.style.display = 'none';
  cancelAnimationFrame(sunAnimId);
  clearInterval(sunTimerId);
  document.removeEventListener('keydown', sunKeyDown);
  document.removeEventListener('keyup', sunKeyUp);
  document.getElementById('sunEndTitle').textContent = won ? '☀️ You Reached the Sun!' : '💥 Solar Fall!';
  document.getElementById('sunEndStats').textContent = 'Height: ' + sunHeight + 'm | Time left: ' + sunTime + 's';
  document.getElementById('sunEndScreen').style.display = 'flex';
}

function sunLoop() {
  if (!sunRunning) return;
  const p = sunPlayer;
  const grav = sunPhys.grav;
  const jumpV = sunPhys.jumpV;
  const speed = sunPhys.speed;
  let move = 0;
  if (sunKeys.left) move = -1;
  else if (sunKeys.right) move = 1;
  else if (Math.abs(sunDragMove) > 0.08) move = sunDragMove;
  if (move !== 0) p.vx = move * speed;
  else p.vx *= 0.75;
  if (sunJumpReq && p.onGround) { p.vy = jumpV; p.onGround = false; }
  sunJumpReq = false;
  p.vy += grav;
  p.x += p.vx;
  p.y += p.vy;
  p.x = Math.max(p.w, Math.min(sunCanvas.width - p.w, p.x));
  if (playerTouchesSun(p)) { endSunClimb(true); return; }
  p.onGround = false;
  sunPlatforms.forEach(pl => {
    if (pl.isSun) return;
    if (p.vy >= 0 && p.y + p.h / 2 >= pl.y && p.y + p.h / 2 <= pl.y + pl.h + p.vy + 2 &&
        p.x + p.w / 2 > pl.x && p.x - p.w / 2 < pl.x + pl.width) {
      p.y = pl.y - p.h / 2;
      p.vy = 0;
      p.onGround = true;
    }
  });
  const playerScreenY = p.y - sunCamY;
  if (playerScreenY > sunCanvas.height + 40) {
    sunLives--;
    updateSunHud();
    if (sunLives <= 0) { endSunClimb(false); return; }
    const sp = sunPlatforms.find(p => p.isStart) || sunPlatforms.filter(p => !p.isSun).reduce((a, b) => (a.y > b.y ? a : b));
    sunStartPlat = sp;
    p.x = sp.x + sp.width / 2;
    p.y = sp.y - 14;
    p.vy = 0;
    sunCamY = sunBottomCamY(sp, sunCanvas.height);
  }
  const bottomCam = sunBottomCamY(sunStartPlat, sunCanvas.height);
  const sunPlat = sunPlatforms.find(pl => pl.isSun);
  const sunCy = sunPlat ? (sunPlat.sunCy || sunPlat.y) : SUN_CENTER_Y;
  const maxCamY = Math.max(0, sunCy + SUN_BODY_RADIUS + SUN_RAY_LEN + 56 - sunCanvas.height);
  const followCam = Math.max(0, p.y - sunCanvas.height * 0.52);
  const stillNearStart = p.y > sunCanvas.height * 0.62;
  const nearSun = p.y < sunCy + SUN_BODY_RADIUS + 100;
  let targetCam;
  if (stillNearStart) {
    targetCam = bottomCam;
  } else if (nearSun) {
    targetCam = Math.max(bottomCam, Math.min(maxCamY, p.y - sunCanvas.height * 0.58));
  } else {
    targetCam = Math.max(bottomCam, followCam);
  }
  targetCam = Math.min(targetCam, maxCamY);
  sunCamY += (targetCam - sunCamY) * 0.15;
  sunHeight = Math.max(sunHeight, Math.floor(-sunCamY / 8));
  if (Math.random() < 0.007) sunFlares.push({ x: Math.random() * sunCanvas.width, y: sunCamY + 60 + Math.random() * 120, w: 32, h: 10, vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4 });
  sunFlares.forEach(f => { f.x += f.vx; });
  sunFlares = sunFlares.filter(f => f.x > -50 && f.x < sunCanvas.width + 50);
  sunFlares.forEach(f => {
    if (Math.abs(p.x - f.x) < 24 && Math.abs(p.y - f.y) < 16) {
      sunLives--;
      updateSunHud();
      f.x = -9999;
      if (sunLives <= 0) { endSunClimb(false); return; }
    }
  });
  drawSunClimb();
  sunAnimId = requestAnimationFrame(sunLoop);
}

function drawSunClimb() {
  const c = sunCtx, W = sunCanvas.width, H = sunCanvas.height;
  const bg = c.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  bg.addColorStop(0, '#1a0800'); bg.addColorStop(1, '#0f0c29');
  c.fillStyle = bg; c.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.25)';
    c.beginPath(); c.arc((i * 97) % W, ((i * 61) % H + sunCamY * 0.1) % H, 1, 0, Math.PI * 2); c.fill();
  }
  sunPlatforms.forEach(pl => {
    const py = pl.y - sunCamY;
    if (py < -30 || py > H + 30) return;
    if (pl.isSun) {
      const cx = pl.sunCx || (pl.x + pl.width / 2);
      const sunR = pl.sunR || SUN_BODY_RADIUS;
      const grd = c.createRadialGradient(cx, py, 5, cx, py, sunR + 5);
      grd.addColorStop(0, '#fff176'); grd.addColorStop(1, '#ff8c00');
      c.fillStyle = grd;
      c.beginPath(); c.arc(cx, py, sunR, 0, Math.PI * 2); c.fill();
      c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,230,120,0.9)';
      c.lineWidth = 4;
      c.lineCap = 'round';
      for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
        const a = (i / 12) * Math.PI * 2 - Math.PI / 2;
        c.beginPath();
        c.moveTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * (sunR - 2), py + Math.sin(a) * (sunR - 2));
        c.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * (sunR + SUN_RAY_LEN), py + Math.sin(a) * (sunR + SUN_RAY_LEN));
        c.stroke();
      }
      c.font = '36px serif'; c.textAlign = 'center'; c.fillText('☀️', cx, py + 12);
    } else {
      c.fillStyle = '#ff9800';
      c.fillRect(pl.x, py, pl.width, pl.h);
      c.fillStyle = '#ffd54f';
      c.fillRect(pl.x + 4, py + 3, pl.width - 8, pl.h - 6);
    }
  });
  sunFlares.forEach(f => {
    const fy = f.y - sunCamY;
    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,100,0,0.85)';
    c.beginPath(); c.ellipse(f.x, fy, f.w / 2, f.h / 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); c.fill();
  });
  const py = sunPlayer.y - sunCamY;
  c.font = '26px serif'; c.textAlign = 'center'; c.textBaseline = 'middle';
  c.fillText('🧑‍🚀', sunPlayer.x, py);
}

        const p = e.changedTouches ? e.changedTouches[0] : e;
        if (!S.dragMoved && p && S.hitPlanet(p.clientX, p.clientY)) S.nextFact();
        if (S.dragging) { S.rot += S.drag; S.drag = 0; S.dragging = false; }
      };
      this.svg.addEventListener('mousedown', onDown);
      window.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
      window.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
      this.svg.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { onDown(e); }, { passive: true });
      this.svg.addEventListener('touchmove', e => { onMove(e); }, { passive: true });
      this.svg.addEventListener('touchend', onUp);
      const loop = () => { if (S.spin) S.ang += 0.012; S.draw(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); };
      this.draw();
      loop();
    },
    hitPlanet(clientX, clientY) {
      const pt = this.svg.createSVGPoint();
      pt.x = clientX;
      pt.y = clientY;
      const m = this.g.getScreenCTM();
      if (!m) return false;
      const p = pt.matrixTransform(m.inverse());
      return p.x * p.x + p.y * p.y <= 88 * 88;
    },
    nextFact() {
      this.fi = (this.fi + 1) % this.facts.length;
      this.info.innerHTML = '<strong>' + label + '</strong><br>' + this.facts[this.fi];
    },
    draw() {
      while (this.g.firstChild) this.g.removeChild(this.g.firstChild);
      this.g.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(200,200) rotate(' + (this.rot + this.drag) + ') scale(' + this.zoom + ') rotate(' + this.ang + ')');
      StylizedPlanet.draw(this.g, planetType, 88);
    }
  };
}

const PlanetViewer = makePlanetViewer('sun', sunFacts, '☀️ The Sun');
try { PlanetViewer.init(); } catch (err) { console.error('Planet viewer:', err); }

</script>
</body>
</html>

steps.title: The Sun Explained
steps.contentHtml:
📚 The Sun Explained

Learn more about our amazing star!

⚛️ What is the Sun Made Of?

The Sun is made mostly of two gases: hydrogen (about 73%) and helium (about 25%). The remaining 2% is made of other elements like oxygen, carbon, and iron.

The Sun creates energy by turning hydrogen into helium in a process called nuclear fusion. This happens in the Sun's core, where it's super hot!

💡 Fun Fact

The Sun uses 600 million tons of hydrogen every second!

🔥 Parts of the Sun

The Sun has different layers, just like Earth has layers:

  • Core - The hottest part where energy is made
  • Radiative Zone - Energy moves through this layer
  • Convective Zone - Hot gas rises and cools gas falls
  • Photosphere - The visible surface we see
  • Corona - The outer atmosphere, super hot!

🌡️ Solar Activity

The Sun is very active! It has things called:

  • Sunspots - Darker, cooler areas on the surface
  • Solar Flares - Big bursts of energy and light
  • Coronal Mass Ejections - Huge clouds of gas that fly into space

Sometimes these can affect Earth! They might cause beautiful auroras (northern lights) or even mess with satellites and power grids.

🌅 Day and Night

Earth rotates (spins) on its axis once every 24 hours. This is why we have day and night. When part of Earth faces the Sun, it's daytime. When it faces away, it's nighttime.

The Sun always rises in the east and sets in the west because of Earth's rotation!

💡 Fun Fact

The Sun is actually a star, just like the stars you see at night - it's just much closer to us!

🔭 The Sun's Future

The Sun has been shining for about 4.6 billion years and will continue for about 5 billion more years. Eventually, it will run out of hydrogen and become a red giant, then a white dwarf.

But don't worry - that won't happen for a very, very long time!

🛡️ Staying Safe

The Sun gives us life, but we need to be careful too:

  • Never look directly at the Sun - it can hurt your eyes!
  • Wear sunscreen to protect your skin from UV rays
  • Wear sunglasses on bright days
  • Stay in the shade during the hottest part of the day

steps.contentHtml:
🌊

Ocean Adventure

An exciting journey into the deep blue sea!

📖 About This Book

Welcome to Ocean Adventure! This book will take you on an amazing journey through the world's oceans. You'll learn about different ocean zones, amazing sea creatures, and why the ocean is so important for our planet.

Get ready to dive deep and discover the wonders of the underwater world!

📚 Book Details

Author
Jimmy Cooper
Age Group
7-8 years
Chapters
32
Theme
Ocean & Sea Life

💬 Author's Message

"Hello, young explorer! I'm Jimmy Cooper, and I created this book to share my love for the ocean with you. From sunny shallows to the deep abyss, every zone has amazing stories. Dive in, play the games, and become an ocean hero!"

🎯 What You'll Learn

  • About the different ocean zones
  • Amazing sea creatures and how they live
  • Why coral reefs are important
  • About marine mammals like dolphins and whales
  • How to protect our oceans

🎮 How to Use This Book

Each chapter has fun activities to help you learn:

  • 📖 Read briefing and index, then choose your diver
  • 🎮 Play the intro game, then explore each topic
  • 🎯 Each topic: activity + explained + quiz
  • 🏆 Finish with conclusion, overall quiz, and finale game

🌊 Why the Ocean Matters

The ocean covers more than 70% of Earth's surface! It's home to millions of amazing creatures and helps keep our planet healthy. Learning about the ocean helps us understand how to protect it for future generations.

📚 Conclusion

What an amazing ocean adventure!

🌟 What You've Learned

Congratulations on completing your journey through the ocean! You've learned about:

  • The ocean and why it's important for our planet
  • The different ocean zones - from sunlight to the deepest hadal trenches
  • Amazing creatures that live in each zone
  • Coral reefs and their incredible biodiversity
  • Marine mammals like whales and dolphins

🔬 The Future of Ocean Exploration

There's still so much to discover! Scientists estimate that we've explored less than 5% of the ocean. New species are being discovered all the time!

New technologies like deep-sea submersibles and underwater robots are helping us explore deeper than ever before.

🌍 Why the Ocean Matters

The ocean is essential for life on Earth:

  • Provides most of the oxygen we breathe
  • Regulates Earth's climate and temperature
  • Provides food for billions of people
  • Home to millions of amazing creatures
  • Inspires wonder and discovery

🛡️ Protecting Our Ocean

The ocean faces many challenges, but we can all help protect it:

  • Reduce plastic use and don't litter
  • Choose sustainable seafood
  • Support marine conservation efforts
  • Learn more and share with others
  • Reduce your carbon footprint

📖 Keep Exploring!

Your ocean adventure is complete, but learning never stops! There's so much more to discover:

  • Learn about specific ocean species
  • Discover more about marine conservation
  • Watch documentaries about the ocean
  • Visit an aquarium or beach
  • Read more books about marine life

tasks.title: AuthGuard & Route Protection
tasks.description: Review Angular AuthGuard implementation, lifecycle hooks, NgRx patterns, and how Angular communicates with .NET Core APIs.
checklist: Explain AuthGuard and route access control
Describe all lifecycle hooks in Angular
Understand NgRx for state management
Explain Angular-to-.NET communication patterns
Understand two-way data binding and routing
tasks.answerHtml:
Sub QuestionAnswerMore ExplanationExampleBenefit
What is AuthGuard?A service that controls route access based on authenticationImplements CanActivate interface; returns boolean or Observable<boolean>Redirect unauthenticated users to login pageSecure routes from unauthorized access
How do you implement AuthGuard?Create service implementing CanActivate interfaceCheck authentication status in canActivate() methodAuthGuard checks JWT token validity before navigationControl route access declaratively
What is ngOnChanges?Lifecycle hook called when input properties changeReceives SimpleChanges object with previous/current valuesDetect when @Input() value updates and respondReact to external property changes
What is ngOnInit?Lifecycle hook called once after component initializationBest place for initialization logic and data fetchingLoad user profile data from API on component startInitialize component safely after inputs are bound
What is ngDoCheck?Lifecycle hook called during every change detection runImplement custom change detection logic hereDetect value changes that Angular's default detection missesImplement custom change detection strategies
What is ngAfterContentInit?Lifecycle hook called after ng-content is projectedInitialize logic that depends on projected contentAccess @ContentChild() after content is projectedInteract with content from parent component
What is ngAfterContentChecked?Lifecycle hook called after every check of ng-contentRuns after ngAfterContentInit and after ngDoCheckPerform additional checks after content initializationRespond to content projection changes
What is ngAfterViewInit?Lifecycle hook called after component view is initializedGood place to access DOM elements and child componentsInitialize jQuery plugins or access native DOMWork with view elements safely
What is ngAfterViewChecked?Lifecycle hook called after every check of component viewRuns after ngAfterViewInit and after change detectionPerform additional checks after view renderingUpdate UI elements after view changes
What is ngOnDestroy?Lifecycle hook called before component is destroyedEssential for cleanup and resource releaseUnsubscribe from observables, clear timers, detach event listenersPrevent memory leaks and cleanup resources
What is NgRx?Redux-inspired state management library for AngularManages application state predictably with immutable dataUse Store to hold user data, dispatch actions on loginCentralized state, easier debugging and testing
What are NgRx Actions?Plain objects representing events or user interactionsActions trigger reducers to update stateLoginAction, LogoutAction, FetchUserActionClear intent of what happened in the application
What are NgRx Reducers?Pure functions that specify state changes in response to actionsTake current state and action, return new stateReducer handles LoginAction by adding user to statePredictable state transitions, easy to test
What are NgRx Effects?Manage side effects like HTTP requests in NgRxListen for actions, perform async operations, dispatch new actionsEffect listens for FetchUserAction, calls API, dispatches LoadUserSuccessSeparate side effects from state management
What are NgRx Selectors?Functions to extract specific pieces of stateMemoized selectors prevent unnecessary component updatesselectUserName selector extracts user.name from storeEfficient state access and component optimization
How do Angular and .NET communicate?Angular uses HttpClient to send requests to .NET APIsCommunication over HTTP/HTTPS with JSON payloadsAngular calls GET /api/users/123 to .NET backendSeamless frontend-backend integration
What is HttpClient?Angular service for making HTTP requestsProvides methods for GET, POST, PUT, DELETE requeststhis.http.get<User>('/api/users')Simplified HTTP communication with observables
How do you handle errors in HTTP calls?Use error callbacks in subscribe() or catchError operator.NET backend provides HTTP status codes; Angular handles errorscatchError() maps 404 to user-friendly messageGraceful error handling and user feedback
What is two-way data binding?Automatic synchronization between model and view using ngModelChanges in view update model; model changes update view[(ngModel)]="user.name" creates two-way bindingReactive UI without manual DOM updates
What is Angular Routing?Client-side routing allowing navigation without page reloadsRouterModule handles URL changes and component switchingRoute to /dashboard or /settings without server requestSingle Page Application (SPA) experience
What is Dependency Injection (DI)?Components request dependencies rather than creating themInjector provides instances through constructor, property, or methodUserService injected into component constructorLoose coupling, easier testing with mock services
What are Angular Directives?Markers on DOM elements that attach Angular behaviorInclude structural (*ngIf, *ngFor) and attribute directives*ngIf="isLoggedIn" hides/shows element based on conditionDeclarative template logic and DOM manipulation
What is CORS?Cross-Origin Resource Sharing - policy for browser requestsConfigured on .NET backend to specify allowed origins.NET allows requests from http://localhost:4200Secure cross-origin API calls
How do you secure Angular-to-.NET communication?Use HTTPS, token-based auth (JWT), and permission validationBackend validates tokens on every requestStore JWT in localStorage, send in Authorization headerProtect sensitive data and user actions
How do you organize an Angular + .NET app?Separate frontend (Angular) and backend (.NET) codebasesOrganize by features/modules, separate concerns/angular-app for frontend, /dotnet-api for backendClear structure, easier maintenance and testing

tasks.title: What is SOLID?
tasks.description: Review the SOLID principles, abstract/interface differences, and polymorphism for interview readiness.
checklist: Explain the SOLID principles in plain language
Describe Abstract class vs Interface
Summarize how polymorphism improves design
tasks.answerHtml:
Sub QuestionAnswerMore ExplanationExampleBenefit
What is SOLIDDesign principles for clean codeReduces complexity and future risksAdd new policy without breaking existing codeMaintainable system
SRP - Single ResponsibilityOne class = one jobAvoid mixed responsibilitiesPremiumCalculator only calculates premiumEasy testing
OCP - Open/ClosedExtend, don’t modifyAdd features without changing old codeAdd TravelPolicy without changing core logicSafer changes
LSP - Liskov SubstitutionChild behaves like parentNo broken behaviour when substitutingMotorPolicy works as PolicyReliable code
ISP - Interface Segregation PrincipleSmall focused interfacesDon’t force unused methodsIClaimable, IRenewable separatedCleaner design
DIP - Dependency InversionDepend on abstractionNot concrete classesClaimService uses IPaymentServiceFlexible + testable
Explain Abstract vs InterfaceAbstract = partial logic, Interface = contractAbstract has code, interface only rulesPolicy vs IClaimableFlexible design
Explain PolymorphismSame method, different behaviourBehaviour depends on objectCalculateClaim varies by policyReusable logic

tasks.title: OOP Fundamentals
tasks.description: Review key object-oriented programming concepts with short definitions, explanations, examples, and benefits.
checklist: Explain the core OOP concepts clearly
Describe how objects, classes, and encapsulation relate
Summarize polymorphism, abstraction, and constructors
tasks.answerHtml:
Sub QuestionAnswerMore ExplanationExampleBenefit
What is Inheritance?Parent-child relationship of classesA subclass inherits properties and methods from its superclass for hierarchy and reuseclass Dog extends Animal {}Reduces duplication and supports extension
What is Polymorphism?One interface, many formsSame call can do different things depending on the object typeadd(int, int) / add(float) or Dog overrides sound()Makes code more flexible and reusable
What is an Object?Instance of a classObjects are concrete runtime values created from class blueprintsDog myDog = new Dog();Enables real-world modeling in code
What is a Class?Blueprint for objectsClasses define the properties and behavior that objects can haveclass Animal { int age; }Structures code and organizes behavior
What is Encapsulation?Protecting data by restricting accessHide state behind methods and control how it changesprivate int age; public int getAge()Improves security and prevents misuse
What is Abstraction?Hide implementation, show only essentialsSimplifies complex systems by exposing only required behaviorabstract class Shape { abstract void draw(); }Simplifies interfaces and reduces complexity
What is a Constructor?Initializes an object automaticallyCalled when an object is created to set up its initial statepublic Dog() { this.age = 1; }Ensures objects start with valid data
What is Method Overload?Same method name, different parametersMultiple methods share a name but accept different argumentsvoid run(int x) & void run(double y)Increases usability without new names
What is the Static keyword?Class-level member, not tied to any objectStatic members belong to the class itself and can be used without instancesstatic int counter;Saves memory and enables shared access
What is an Interface?Defines methods a class must implementInterfaces declare required behavior without implementationinterface Animal { void eat(); }Promotes consistent, testable design

tasks.title: Performance
tasks.description: Review Angular performance considerations, change detection, and when to optimize templates and observations.
checklist: Explain how change detection impacts Angular performance
Describe when to use OnPush change detection
Identify expensive template expressions to avoid
Summarize lazy loading and module splitting benefits
Mention the cost of large watch lists or observable subscriptions
tasks.answerHtml:
Sub QuestionAnswerMore ExplanationExampleBenefit
How does change detection affect performance?More checks mean more workAngular inspects bindings on each change detection cycleLarge component trees run slowerUnderstand render cost
When use OnPush?For immutable inputs and fewer checksComponent only checks when inputs change or events occur@Component({ changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush })Reduces unnecessary cycles
What are expensive template expressions?Functions or complex logic inside templatesThey run on every change detection pass{{ computeValue(item) }}Prefer pipes and memoized values
How does lazy loading help?Load modules only when neededReduces initial bundle size and startup cost{ path: 'admin', loadChildren: () => import('./admin/admin.module') }Faster initial load
Why limit subscriptions and watchers?Each one adds runtime overheadUnmanaged subscriptions can leak and slow the apptakeUntil(destroy$)More stable, efficient code
